Table.Name: Command_1
Table.Command: SELECT Network.Name AS NetworkName, InstrumentGroup.Name AS InstrumentGroupName, Instrument.Name AS InstrumentName, Instrument.SerialNumber AS SerialNumber FROM tblMfCdNetwork Network INNER JOIN tblMfCdInstrumentGroup InstrumentGroup ON InstrumentGroup.SystemID = Network.SystemID AND InstrumentGroup.NetworkID = Network.NetworkID AND InstrumentGroup.Obsolete = 0 INNER JOIN tblMfCdInstrument Instrument ON Instrument.SystemID = InstrumentGroup.SystemID AND Instrument.InstrumentGroupLogicalID = InstrumentGroup.InstrumentGroupLogicalID AND Instrument.Obsolete = 0 WHERE Instrument.SystemID = {?@SystemID} AND Instrument.InstrumentLogicalID = {?@InstrumentLogicalID}
